raw.description:
Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Remote (UK-based), with occasional on-site work at our data centres | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 50+ of the world’s leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what’s technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to help run and grow the network and cloud estate behind our trading platform. Networking in our colocation data centres is the core of the role. The estate spans London, New York and Singapore, and from Q1 2027 a new Tokyo data centre.

This is a hands-on role in a small, expert infrastructure team. You’ll work closely with our Head of Infrastructure, following problems from the cross-connect through hosts, containers and AWS. You’ll also help keep infrastructure delivery on track, from timelines and reporting to working closely with our TechOps team.

What You’ll Work On

  • Low-latency networking across our colocation sites: switching and routing, cross-connects, BGP peering with liquidity providers and clients, and the fabric that carries our trading traffic

  • Bringing new sites to application-ready, starting with Tokyo

  • Our hybrid connectivity into multi-region AWS, including Direct Connect, routing and failover

  • Linux hosts and containers on the critical path, with every change made through code (Ansible, Git, Terraform), never by hand

  • Monitoring and alerting that catches problems before clients do, plus runbooks and post-incident reviews that someone else can follow

  • Planning and capacity: forecasting growth, setting timelines and reporting progress to TechOps and engineering

What We Need

  • 4+ years running production infrastructure in a latency-sensitive environment, such as HFT, an exchange, market data or bank trading infrastructure

  • Strong networking: hands-on routing and switching (MLAG, LACP, VLANs), BGP in production, and a solid grasp of low-latency behaviour such as buffers, microbursts and congestion handling

  • Colocation experience: cabinets, cross-connects, remote hands and vendor management

  • Solid Linux (RHEL) and TCP/IP, and the ability to trace a problem from the wire to the application

  • Infrastructure as code and containers as your default way of working

  • Working knowledge of AWS networking, and the confidence to pick up the rest of our stack. Networking depth matters more to us than any particular cloud or platform tooling

  • Methodical, evidence-led troubleshooting and clear documentation

A strong plus:

  • Project management experience: owning timelines, reporting progress, and working with ops teams to hit deadlines

  • Kernel bypass (Onload/ef_vi), PTP and time synchronisation

  • Experience bringing up a new colo site

  • FIX protocol or OTC FX market knowledge

  • Python for tooling

Working pattern: Infrastructure changes are often scheduled outside trading hours, including weekends, and the team shares an on-call rota. We’re a team with flexible hours, so time worked out of hours is taken back during the week. Day-to-day work is remote, with occasional visits to our data centres, most often in London (Slough).

What You Get

  • Real ownership of a live global trading network, hands-on, with few layers of process

  • A build-out year, with a new Tokyo data centre in Q1 and more growth ahead

  • A senior seat in a small, expert team where your changes ship and are measured

  • Competitive package — up to 38 days leave (inc. bank holidays), private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly working with flexibility around out-of-hours work

  • Growth as the estate scales

We believe in transparency, honest feedback and writing things down, and we aim to build systems that don’t depend on the heroics of individuals.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages:

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Technical Deep Dive with our Head of Infrastructure
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~90 minutes

Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with our CDO
Format: Video call, ~45 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you’re invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you’ll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies. Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape. Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Engage with product management to provide insight into prospect and customer needs and industry trends. Influence the roadmap for market success. Work with the extended team to ensure that they are successful and learn from your expertise. Mentor and partner with other SCs to build their success. Have an agile and adaptable mentality, and can quickly implement new customer engagement processes. raw.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager
raw.description:
Job title: Strategic Partnerships Manager

Location: London; full in-office working as default

Start date: ASAP

Reports to: CRO

Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion

Application deadline: 01/11/26 at 23:59 UK time

___________________________________________________________________________

Help build the UK's sovereign AI future. Turn cutting-edge technology into commercial impact.

At Cosine, we're on a mission to build the UK's first sovereign Large Language Model, alongside some of the most advanced AI technology being developed today.

Our portfolio spans autonomous coding agents, specialised AI models, AI-native red teaming and sovereign AI solutions. We're building technology that fundamentally changes how organisations develop software, modernise infrastructure, strengthen security and deploy AI where control over data and infrastructure is critical.

The opportunity is significant. The interest is already there. Now we need someone who can turn it into business.

We're looking for an exceptional Partnerships Manager to build and scale Cosine's partner ecosystem, with an immediate focus on systems integrators (SIs) and consultancies.

This is a commercially driven, hands-on role. You'll own relationships, develop joint propositions, negotiate agreements and build customer pipeline. You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at major partners and closely with our commercial, product and engineering teams.

This isn't about managing an established partner programme. It's about building one that delivers.

We need someone who can hit the ground running, operate independently and turn opportunities into results.

___________________________________________________________________________

What you'll do

Build and activate strategic partnerships

  • Own and develop relationships across the partner ecosystem, prioritising high-value SIs, consultancies and strategic technology partners.

  • Convert existing interest into active, commercially productive partnerships while proactively opening new doors.

  • Build relationships with senior executives, practice leaders and commercial teams, creating alignment and securing commitment.

Turn partnerships into revenue

  • Drive partner opportunities from initial engagement through commercial negotiation, agreement and activation.

  • Build joint account plans, identify customer opportunities and develop a qualified pipeline with clear commercial objectives.

  • Work with partners and internal sales teams to progress opportunities into pilots, deployments and revenue.

  • Take accountability for outcomes. Signed agreements matter, but active partners, customer engagements and revenue matter more.

Create propositions that partners can sell

  • Work with product, engineering and commercial teams to develop compelling joint propositions around sovereign AI, coding agents, software modernisation and cybersecurity.

  • Understand partner capabilities and customer challenges, identifying where Cosine's technology creates real commercial value.

  • Translate complex technology into clear, differentiated propositions that partners can confidently take to market.

Get hands-on and make things happen

  • Run product demonstrations, partner workshops and enablement sessions. You'll need to understand our technology, not just talk about it.

  • Equip partner teams to identify opportunities, position Cosine effectively and engage customers.

  • Navigate commercial, technical and organisational challenges to keep deals moving.

  • Build the processes, reporting and partner engagement model needed to scale what works, without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

___________________________________________________________________________

What we’re looking for

We want someone who has built partnerships that generate business, not simply managed relationships.

You'll bring:

  • A proven commercial track record. Demonstrable success building partnerships, developing pipeline and delivering revenue within enterprise technology, software or AI.

  • Strong SI and consultancy experience. You understand how these organisations operate, how to navigate their internal structures and what it takes to turn strategic alignment into real customer opportunities.

  • Commercial sharpness. You know how to qualify opportunities, negotiate agreements, develop compelling commercial propositions and focus effort where it delivers the greatest return.

  • Technical credibility. You're comfortable engaging with complex enterprise technology, running product demonstrations and holding meaningful conversations with technical stakeholders. You don't need to be an engineer, but you must be capable of getting under the skin of our products.

  • Executive-level relationship skills. You can engage confidently with senior decision-makers, build credibility quickly and influence stakeholders across large organisations.

  • Relentless execution. You're proactive, resourceful and commercially driven. You take ownership, follow through and don't need someone else to create momentum.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset. You thrive in fast-moving environments, make sound decisions with incomplete information and are equally comfortable shaping strategy and doing the work yourself.

Experience working with government, defence, financial services or other regulated industries would be a strong advantage.

Above all, we're looking for someone with the ambition, judgement and drive to build something exceptional.

___________________________________________________________________________

Why join Cosine

Work on technology that matters. Our sovereign LLM ambition and broader AI portfolio address some of the biggest challenges facing enterprises and governments today. You'll help build the partnerships that take these capabilities into the real world.

A genuine opportunity to make an impact. We're already seeing significant partner interest. You'll have the opportunity to convert that momentum into commercial results and play a direct role in our growth.

Ownership, not bureaucracy. You'll have meaningful responsibility, direct access to decision-makers and the freedom to shape how we build our partner ecosystem. We're moving quickly, and we value people who make things happen.

Build something from the ground up. This is an opportunity to help define Cosine's partnership strategy and establish relationships that could become fundamental to how we scale.

Come and build with us

We're looking for someone who's ambitious, commercially driven and excited by the opportunity to help bring frontier AI technology to market.

Someone who can think strategically, roll their sleeves up and deliver.

If you've got the track record, the drive and the ambition to help build something significant, we'd like to hear from you.

___________________________________________________________________________


Cosine is an equal opportunity employer.


We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace.

We encourage applications from anyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, we’re happy to discuss them.

___________________________________________________________________________

Compensation, Benefits & Ways of Working

We’re an in-office team, five days a week, by design. We believe the work we’re doing benefits from being together, collaborating closely, and building shared context.

What you can expect:

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market

  • Equity / share options, so you share in the upside you help create

  • 30 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Work hard in the office, collaborate closely, and switch off properly

  • Dog-friendly office — bring your dog to work

  • Weekly team breakfast & lunch

  • Monthly socials

  • Pension

  • High-quality equipment to do your best work

We care about focus, sustainability, and doing great work — not performative overwork. We value people who show up, contribute thoughtfully, collaborate well with their colleagues, and then go home.

This role won’t suit everyone. But if you’re looking for a fast-moving environment, close collaboration, and a team that takes both the work and work-life balance seriously, it’s a great place to be.

The Role

About the Software organisation at Fractile

Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.

About the team and role

The Developer Experience team at Fractile helps shape how our customers interact with the Fractile inference accelerator. We work across the company to identify, create, and present information on how the system is being used, as well as providing the tooling to help optimise our customers' usage of the system, while keeping a shallow learning curve.

As a member of the Developer Experience team you will need to understand the current state of development for inference hardware. You will need to be able to identify what will work well for engineers wanting to identify potential opportunities for performance improvements, while knowing what tooling will fit into an existing LLM engineer's workflow with the minimal amount of disruption and effort.

About you

We're looking for someone who is self-driven and capable of identifying tooling opportunities, designing those tools, and delivering them in a way which will fit in with an LLM engineer's existing toolset. You will have worked in this area before, possibly as an FDE or at a company that provides inference services using their own models, and have the ability to develop new tools that are designed to be functional and easy to learn and use.

Key Requirements

  • Experience with inference frameworks such as JAX and/or PyTorch

  • Experience of software development in Python, Rust, C/C++, or a similar language

  • Experience monitoring and optimising code written in CUDA, ROCm, OpenCL, or similar

  • Experience monitoring and optimising LLM deployments with 50+ billion parameters

  • Experience working with stakeholders across multiple teams

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

description: 👋 Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate! ✨🏗️ We’d love to hear from you 👩‍💻👩🏽‍💻🧑🏿‍💻👨🏻‍💻 📝 Overview The SMB Account Manager will manage a portfolio of ~200 SMB customers, proactively hunting for upsell and cross-sell opportunities while ensuring strong renewal outcomes. This person will run structured account reviews, spot workflow gaps, and position additional products or plan/user upgrades that deepen customer value. Success requires strong time and calendar management to balance a high-volume book of business while maintaining enough depth to uncover meaningful commercial plays. Working closely with CSMs, AEs and Product, the AM will use Sitemate’s AM frameworks and playbooks to drive adoption and revenue growth. Employment: Salary: OTE Remuneration: £78,000 (incl Pension) Base Salary: £54,600 (incl Pension) Commission: £23,400 (incl Pension) About Sitemate: Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world. Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records. The SMB Account Manager will manage a portfolio of ~200 SMB customers, proactively hunting for upsell and cross-sell opportunities while ensuring strong renewal outcomes. This person will run structured account reviews, spot workflow gaps, and position additional products or plan/user upgrades that deepen customer value. Success requires strong time and calendar management to balance a high-volume book of business while maintaining enough depth to uncover meaningful commercial plays. Working closely with CSMs, AEs and Product, the AM will use Sitemate’s AM frameworks and playbooks to drive adoption and revenue growth.

Employment:

  • Salary:

About Sitemate:

Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world.

Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records.

With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture.

Our core platforms are Dashpivot (safety, quality and field reporting), Gearbelt (fleet and asset management), Flowsite (no-code integrations), and the Sitemate mobile app for every worker on site.

We have strong product-market fit, generating thousands of new leads per month through word of mouth and organic channels. We are backed by Blackbird, with 200 people across 18+ countries and entities in Australia, the UK, the US and Canada.

 

Life at Sitemate

At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation as the principles we work by every day.

We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure.

We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51.

 

Our Core Values

Our core values dictate “how we work”. We believe that basic human values such as honesty, trust and integrity are required to simply ‘get in the door’. Our values are designed to help us determine if an already great person, will be a great fit at Sitemate.

  • Handle with Care: Handle with thought and care, decisions are considered and consciously delivered

  • Everything Engineered: Everything engineered, intentional, planned and systematic

  • Quality Certified: Do it well, with attention to detail and accuracy, or don’t do it at all

  • Fast Tracked: Fast, incremental, and constant delivery of change

  • High Vis: A high visibility, transparent and  open environment

  • Rain, Hail or Shine: Show up for your team, your customers and yourself

Learn more about our values:

  • Read:

    • On Sitemate's Values, Culture and DNA

  • Listen:

    • Unleashing your Zilla

    • On scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture

What We Offer

  • Competitive, performance-based remuneration

  • Equity options - own a piece of what you’re helping to build

  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave

  • Parental leave - 16 weeks for primary and 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support)

  • Learning & Development - professional growth budget and transparent career plans

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - for confidential counseling, mental health support, and life resources

  • Laptop and home office setup budget

  • Flexible work - a hybrid rhythm, with 2 to 3 days in office, 2 WFH each week - with the flexibility to work from anywhere for several weeks a year

  • Community & Connection - weekly catered lunches, global offsites, and “Life Story” sessions

  • London office perks - large private outdoor terrace, on-site showers & bike storage, surrounded by cafés, galleries & vibrant nightlife in the heart of Shoreditch and a 5-minute walk to Old Street tube

Equal Opportunity

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities. Our team’s diversity is one of our greatest strengths, and we’re committed to ensuring an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

 

Learn More About Sitemate

🎧 Podcasts

  • 2026: CRO Lance Hodgson - on why the built world is jumping straight to AI and what that changes

  • 2024: CEO Hartley Pike - on scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture

  • 2022: CTO Tim Bray - on building quality features that solve real customer problems

💬 Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team: People of Sitemate
⭐ Read what our customers say: G2 Crowd, Trust Radius
🎥 Team Offsites: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025

🔧 Day-to-Day

  • Run structured account review meetings with SMB customers to uncover workflow gaps and position relevant product use cases.

  • Prospect within a ~200-account book by booking discovery conversations and identifying upsell / cross-sell opportunities.

  • Manage renewal cycles end-to-end, including pricing, negotiation, and contracting.

  • Partner closely with CSMs to stay across customer context, risks and timing to align commercial plays with customer readiness.

  • Prioritise accounts and organise your calendar to balance long-term expansion plays with short-term commercial activities.

  • Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, pipeline updates, and forecasting across all open opportunities.

  • Collaborate with, SMB Customer Success Managers, SMB Account Executives and Product teams to provide feedback on customer needs and product adoption.

⚡ Challenges

  • Balancing a relatively high-volume portfolio (200 accounts) in a fact paced SMB velocity environment while maintaining enough depth to spot and advance meaningful expansion opportunities.

  • "Hunting" and prioritising within 200 accounts to book in account review meetings to search for opportunities Timing commercial conversations appropriately, ensuring opportunities are pursued when customers are genuinely ready.

  • Navigating stakeholders within construction and engineering clients, where decision cycles can be long, informal, or influenced by non-technical factors.

  • Driving commercial outcomes in accounts where budget constraints, legacy tools, or competing priorities can slow momentum or stall deals.

✅ Who This Role is For

  • Someone who thrives in a fast paced environment and loves uncovering, shaping, and delivering customer value.

  • A proactive operator who’s comfortable running multiple deal cycles at once across 200 accounts and knows how to create momentum with busy operational stakeholders.

  • Someone who collaborates well with CSMs and cross-functional teams, but ultimately enjoys owning a revenue number and being accountable for results.

🚫 Who This Role is Not For

  • Someone who prefers a steady, account-management-style role focused on long-term relationship building rather than fast-moving new business sales.

  • Someone who sees “commercial” as purely transactional and isn’t motivated by understanding customer value drivers to position meaningful, outcomes-led upsell opportunities.

Nice to Have:

  • Built world landscape knowledge & experience

Essential Tools:

  • Salesforce

  • Microsoft Office Suite

Bonus Tools:

  • Front

  • Slack

  • Loom

  • We hire directly and don’t work with agencies

Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. The team Broker Flow, a new team in iwoca's third-party acquisition department, owns the journey for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – from before they apply to a completed credit assessment. The role As the Data Scientist in Broker Flow, you'll give the team the evidence behind its product decisions. The core of the work is experiment design and causal inference, with modelling and analysis alongside it. You'll own each project end to end. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles. Bonus: Modelling depth. Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services. Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python. Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

You'll own each project end to end. You'll frame the problem, choose the method, build the model or run the test, and take the answer to the commercial and strategy colleagues who act on it.   • Reintroductions. Testing the best moment for brokers to bring existing iwoca customers back to borrow.

  • Approval probability. Measuring how well the estimate brokers see in the Introducer Portal predicts actual credit decisions, and making it more accurate.

  • Stochastic methods. You've used stochastic processes for inference or time-series modelling.

  • Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

description: <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.<br><br>The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.<br><br>AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.<br><br>The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.<br><br>Endor Labs is the third company from Founder &amp; CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.<br><br>Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Your goal is to empower customers to leverage our technology fully and ensure they achieve their security and development objectives.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You Bring to the Table</strong></span></h2> <p>We're on the hunt for someone who is not just looking for a job but likes a bit of adventure, too! description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong>Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF</strong></p> <p><strong>About Central Functions</strong></p> <p>Central Functions is formed of the teams and people that serve the entire business. These people are integral to the smooth running of the business; ensuring everyone is paid on time, that materials are sourced and arrive promptly, that we meet our legal obligations and that our health, safety, and security is safeguarded.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Graduate Data &amp; Insight Analyst at THG?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>As Graduate Data &amp; Insight Analyst, you will support the delivery of consumer and market insight across THG’s Beauty and Nutrition divisions. This is an entry-level role for a curious, analytically minded graduate who wants to build a career in insight and market research. You will work closely with the Insight Manager and Insight Lead to learn research methodology, develop your analytical skills and contribute to insight that informs senior decisions across the group.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Research Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support delivery of primary and secondary research projects — data collection, coding, analysis and report preparation</li> <li>Maintain and update brand tracking, NPS and consumer panel datasets</li> <li>Research competitors, market trends and consumer behaviour — collating and summarising Full-time | Permanent

 

About Us

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation and strategic impact across the business.

 

Whether your expertise is in Finance, HR, Technology, Marketing, Data, Legal, Operations or another specialist area, your work will help support colleagues and practices to deliver outstanding care to animals and their owners.

 

 

About the role

Lead the Future of Veterinary Clinical Research

At inspiring vet care, we're committed to advancing veterinary medicine through innovation, collaboration and evidence-based care. We're looking for an experienced Group Clinical Trials Manager to play a pivotal role in developing and delivering sponsored clinical trials across our international network of veterinary practices.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape and grow a clinical trials function within one of the world's leading veterinary groups. Working with sponsors, contract research organisations (CROs) and clinical teams across Europe and North America, you'll drive the successful delivery of pivotal clinical trials while helping to build enthusiasm and capability for clinical research throughout our network.

 


What You'll Be Doing

As Group Clinical Trials Manager, you'll take ownership of the operational delivery of multiple clinical trials, ensuring they are delivered efficiently, compliantly and to the highest standards.

 

 

Key responsibilities include:

*Managing the day-to-day operation of clinical trials across veterinary clinics
*Acting as the primary point of contact for sponsors throughout the trial lifecycle
*Building and maintaining strong relationships with sponsors and CRO partners
*Developing project plans, timelines and risk management strategies
*Recruiting and onboarding veterinary clinics into clinical studies
*Supporting and delivering GCP and protocol-specific training
*Driving study enrolment and engagement activities to maximise participation
*Providing expert guidance on protocol implementation and study delivery
*Monitoring study progress and troubleshooting operational challenges
*Managing and supporting a team of regional Clinical Trial Coordinators
*Ensuring trial activities comply with GCP and all relevant regulations

 

 

About You

We're looking for a highly organised and collaborative clinical trials professional who thrives in a fast-paced, stakeholder-focused environment.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role:  We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth. You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. In this role you will: Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale. You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. Minimum requirements for the role: Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement.  A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale.  Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams. A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously.  An ideal candidate also has:   Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services. Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies.   Why Join Samsara?   Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy.  Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results.  Grow with us: We're scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement.  Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working  At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person. We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform. This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch. We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one. This role will be based in London , UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin. What you'll do: Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers. Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout. Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times. Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer. Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter. Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team. Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event. Our expectations: 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production. 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly. A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one. Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar). Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability. Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality. Nice to have Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud. Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path. Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go. Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP). Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes. What we value A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output. Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them. A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments. Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together. An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker. raw.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.
  • A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.
  • An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

Level up your product area’s sales motion by revamping core pitch materials, competitive positioning, and objection handling. Partner with Product to translate customer and market insights into clear roadmap recommendations. Contribute to a whimsical side quest that adds to our brand and community. Represent RevenueCat at industry events and conferences Deepen your knowledge of app development and monetization, becoming an expert in the space. Move payroll onto our in-house platform in each country where we hold a local entity, covering statutory registration, data migration, parallel running, and cutover. Set up and run payroll for a separate US entity on its own system ahead of a planned handover to local ownership. Build and maintain the payroll operating rhythm (calendars, SOPs, controls, knowledge-base materials) with regular audits across payroll, HRIS, benefits, and provider data. Hold external providers and country contacts to agreed timescales, and resolve discrepancies before they reach an employee's pay. Answer employee questions on pay, pension, and benefits quickly, accurately, and confidentially, against a published response standard. You have owned UK payroll cycles from start to finish, have credible US payroll exposure (direct processing, EOR coordination, or advisor management), and have reconciled payroll against HRIS or entity data across several countries. Benefits and pensions administration experience, including enrollments, leavers, provider invoices, payroll deductions, UK auto-enrollment, member data, and annual renewals. Experience producing payroll reporting for Finance and supporting close, accruals, reconciliations, and audit, with strong documentation and control discipline. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and fluency across payroll, HRIS, benefits, and accounting systems, with close attention to data accuracy. Ses missions sont d’accompagner le quotidien des salariés d’Airbus Opérations Toulouse en leur proposant divers services (restauration collective, médiathèque, offre d’activités et de séjours pour les enfants, voyages, activités sportives et accès à des équipements…) dont une billeterie qui donne accès à une large gamme de produits et de prestations à des tarifs préférentiels ( bons d’achats auprès de diverses enseignes, centres de bien-être et piscines, cinémas, salles de sport, parcs d’attraction, théâtres et activités culturelles, concerts et spectacles…).

Dans le cadre d’un départ à la retraite, nous recherchons un(e) Responsable service billetterie H/F

Vos missions

En tant que responsable du service, vous prenez en charge le pilotage de l’activité billetterie et l’animation d’une équipe d’accueil de 7 personnes. Vos missions comprennent :

  •   la définition de l’offre, de la politique tarifaire et d’achats associée,

  •   la gestion des flux financiers et des encaissements,

  •  l’organisation du planning et l’accompagnement de votre équipe afin de garantir la qualité de l’accueil et la satisfaction des bénéficiaires.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description: Chez  Exotec , nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. De la modélisation d’un entrepôt en 3D au dimensionnement d’une solution Skypod (solution robotisée de stockage et de préparation de commandes pour les entrepôts logistiques), en passant par l’optimisation des coûts et la préparation du déploiement, Studio accompagne les équipes Exotec à chaque étape de leurs projets. En tant que Senior Java Software Engineer , vous contribuez à faire évoluer cet outil stratégique en concevant et développant son backend et ses API. Vous intervenez sur des problématiques techniques variées, allant des moteurs de règles métier aux intégrations avec l’écosystème Exotec, avec un objectif : proposer des solutions fiables, performantes et adaptées aux besoins des utilisateurs. En lien étroit avec les équipes techniques, produit et métier, vous participez activement aux choix de conception et à l’amélioration continue de Studio, afin de faciliter la conception et le déploiement des solutions robotiques Exotec à travers le monde. Vos missions Développer le backend de Studio : concevoir et faire évoluer les services Java et Spring Boot, les API et les fonctionnalités liées à la conception 3D, au dimensionnement des solutions et au calcul des coûts. Concevoir les intégrations : développer et maintenir les connecteurs avec les outils de chiffrage, AutoCAD et les API de l’écosystème Exotec, notamment ICT et MCP. Garantir la qualité du produit : assurer la performance, la robustesse et la fiabilité des applications, analyser les incidents de production et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du code. Contribuer à la livraison continue : participer aux processus CI/CD, aux releases et à la validation des évolutions avec GitLab. Collaborer avec les équipes : recueillir les besoins des utilisateurs, travailler avec les équipes produit, frontend, commerciales et projets, et participer aux rituels agiles de l’équipe. Profil Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation de niveau Bac+5 en informatique ou en informatique industrielle, et justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en développement web . Vous disposez des compétences suivantes : Vous maîtrisez Java et l’écosystème JEE, notamment Spring et Spring Boot. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des technologies web et de la conception d’API. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL, ainsi qu’avec les environnements Linux. Vous maîtrisez les outils de gestion de versions et de développement collaboratif, notamment GitLab. Vous connaissez idéalement un framework JavaScript, tel que React ou Vue.js. Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel. Structuré(e), rigoureux(se) et imaginatif(ve), vous savez prendre des initiatives et proposer des solutions pragmatiques. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes à l’aise pour collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés, dans un environnement de travail convivial. Poste soumis à astreinte. Votre rôle Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, composée de 6 ingénieurs, vous contribuez à améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la disponibilité des systèmes robotiques Exotec. Notre mission : exploiter les données et analyser les défaillances pour améliorer la robustesse et la durée de vie de nos systèmes, tout en réduisant les arrêts opérationnels. À l’interface entre hardware et software, vous identifiez les causes racines des défaillances, développez des outils d’analyse et pilotez des améliorations techniques. Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du système, de l’analyse des données terrain au développement et à la validation de solutions concrètes. Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, vos missions sont les suivantes : Analyser les défaillances et améliorer la fiabilité : exploiter les données terrain, identifier les principaux modes de panne, rechercher les causes racines et définir des actions correctives et préventives. Développer des outils d’analyse : concevoir vos propres outils software pour exploiter les données, diagnostiquer les problèmes et évaluer les performances des systèmes. Développer et tester des solutions logicielles : réaliser des développements de software embarqué en autonomie afin de tester vos améliorations et de résoudre des problématiques à l’interface entre hardware et software. Contribuer à l’évolution des systèmes : travailler avec les équipes de conception pour améliorer les composants, les sous-systèmes et les architectures hardware. Concevoir et réaliser des essais : définir des protocoles de test, mener des expérimentations sur des systèmes dédiés à la R&D et mesurer l’efficacité des améliorations apportées. Enrichir votre connaissance des systèmes sur le terrain : participer au support client pour mieux comprendre les conditions d’utilisation, investiguer les problèmes rencontrés et identifier de nouvelles pistes d’amélioration. Votre profil Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation supérieure technique en mécatronique, systèmes embarqués, génie industriel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou vous avez acquis une expérience équivalente. Vous avez une expérience en conception, développement ou validation de systèmes techniques et manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche de panne et l’analyse des causes racines. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils de développement, le versioning et l’analyse de données. Vous appréciez les problématiques à l’interface entre software et hardware et êtes capable de comprendre les interactions entre les différents composants d’un système. Vous êtes familier(ère) avec les méthodes quantitatives appliquées à la fiabilité : MTTF, MTBF, loi de Weibull ou analyse statistique des défaillances. Vous êtes curieux(se), structuré(e) et rigoureux(se), avec une approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes. Vous savez remettre en question vos hypothèses, approfondir vos analyses et rechercher de nouvelles connaissances lorsque cela est nécessaire. Vous aimez collaborer avec des ingénieurs aux expertises variées, qu’elles soient orientées hardware, software ou systèmes. Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. raw.title: Senior ML Engineer
raw.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer, powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data, and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach.

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions, across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

  • Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

  • Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

  • Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

  • Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems.

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential, with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

You will play a key role in delivering ML initiatives across the company, helping turn promising ideas into reliable production systems. You'll work on everything from model development and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, while contributing to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices

Your responsibilities

 

ML Systems & Delivery

  • Deliver end-to-end ML use cases (recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation models, etc.).

  • Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models where appropriate.

  • Balance speed of delivery with robustness and reliability.

ML Lifecycle & Reliability

  • Drive improvements across the ML lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring, iteration).

  • Establish KPIs and monitoring standards to track model performance over time.

  • Ensure continuous alignment with product and safety objectives.

  • Help improve the reliability and observability of production ML systems.

Platform & Standardization

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform through tools, workflows, and reusable components.

  • Help establish and promote scalable ML engineering practices across teams.

  • Contribute to improving self-service ML capabilities where relevant.

Legacy & Advanced Use Cases

  • Take ownership of legacy models and realign them with current business needs.

  • Improve, retrain, and integrate them into modern pipelines.

  • Contribute to best practices around LLM usage in moderation, recommendation, and other product domains.

  • Explore and implement advanced ML approaches where relevant.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering, MLOps, Backend Platform, and Product teams.

  • Act as a bridge between ML, platform, and business stakeholders.

  • Provide technical leadership on ML initiatives and help improve engineering practices across teams.

  • Share knowledge and help raise the overall ML maturity of the organization.

 

Our technical environment / ML scope

  • ML frameworks: PyTorch

  • Languages: Python (data stack)

  • Core topics: Neural networks, LLMs, data sampling

  • Use cases: Recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation

  • Ecosystem: Data Engineering, MLOps pipelines, Backend Platform

 

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in ML / Data, including work on large-scale datasets (datasets of hundreds of gigabytes).

  • You have strong expertise in modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch or JAX).

  • You are highly proficient in Python (data ecosystem).

  • You have strong knowledge of neural networks and practical experience with LLM-based systems.

  • You understand ML systems end-to-end (data → training → deployment → monitoring).

  • You have strong experience in production ML systems, not only research.

  • You demonstrate strong product sense and can align models with business needs.

  • You are pragmatic and impact-driven, balancing experimentation with delivery.

  • You are able to explain complex ML topics clearly (strong pedagogy).

  • You operate well under ambiguity and can structure complex problems.

  • You are able to drive technical decisions and influence stakeholders through expertise and collaboration.

 

In your first 6 months, you will

  • Deliver an end-to-end ML use case to validate impact and execution.

  • Audit and improve lifecycle management of existing ML models.

  • Refactor and retrain at least one legacy safety model.

  • Build reusable ML components that improve development efficiency across teams.

  • Improve monitoring and observability of production ML systems.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices.

  • Help move critical ML systems toward more reliable and measurable long-term operation.

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with a Talent Acquisition Manager

  • Interview with Mikael (Platform Engineering Director)

  • Technical case study

  • Cultural fit assessments

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A highly flexible remote work policy, 2 days at the office per month, with monthly team events.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

For the sorter, whose design is already set, take over the installed system and optimise it after go-live.</li> <li>Work side by side with the OEM / integrator engineers: collect technical knowledge, challenge design choices, maintainability, access, spare-part strategy and the proposed maintenance plan before they are frozen.</li> <li>Define and verify the Maintenance acceptance criteria (documentation, training, spare parts, safety, availability targets). The Maintenance sign-off is mandatory: no handover to operations without it.</li> <li>Track and drive to closure the technical punch list and warranty issues raised during commissioning and the warranty period.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Training &amp; technical support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Train the operational maintenance team (technicians and operatives) on the equipment, its software/HMI and the troubleshooting procedures; validate their autonomy level.</li> <li>Act as the level-2 / level-3 technical expert for the equipment family on site and remotely, across sites.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>5. Escalation, vendor &amp; SLA management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own technical escalations through to resolution: with the Tetris team (Vinted's internal tools and sorting logic) when the issue is on the software or data side, and with OEM / integrator support (SAV) when it is on the equipment side.</li> <li>Lead the diagnosis that tells which side an issue comes from (equipment, controls, Vinted software), with facts and data.</li> <li>Work within the after-sales and maintenance agreements already in place with OEMs: make the most of them day to day, monitor performance against SLAs and warranty terms, feed lessons learned into future renewals, and provide the technical evidence to the program managers, who own the contractual relationship.</li> <li>Prepare and lead technical review meetings with OEMs and integrators.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>6. Our objective is to treat our infrastructure as a product for our developers, managing its complexity so they don’t have to. We provide simple, ready-to-use tools that enable them to build, deploy, and run their services efficiently.. If you are interested in topics like SRE practices and platform engineering, you will play a key role in our transformation. - Establish your own niche within a highly-skilled team that is eager to learn, share knowledge, and progress together.
